item.title: Albert Manzone Named Honorary Consul of Monaco in Chicago
item.description: Albert Manzone is appointed as Monaco's Honorary Consul in Chicago to enhance commercial ties and promote exchanges with the Midwest region of the US.

item.title: Princess Stephanie Criticizes 'Grace of Monaco' Film
item.description: Nicole Kidman’s 'Grace of Monaco' sparks controversy as Princess Stephanie voices strong disapproval of the film's portrayal of Prince Rainier and Monaco.

item.title: France Ranks Lowest in EU for English Proficiency
item.description: Education First study shows France's English proficiency is the worst in the EU, with cultural identity and poor education quality as major challenges.

item.title: Exploring the Wild Beauty of France’s National Parks
item.description: France is home to some of the most breathtaking national parks in Europe, each offering unique landscapes and biodiversity. Among these, the Provence Alpes Côte d’Azur (PACA) region boasts three exceptional parks: Calanques, Port-Cros, and Mercantour. These parks not only protect the natural environment but also provide visitors with stunning views and rich ecological treasures.
